strings.zh: 咳,咳,啊,啊{SCROLL}……嗯,我是台长！{SCROLL}从今天开始{NEWLINE}我台将开始播放{CLEAR}颂扬火箭队的精彩节目！{SCROLL}大家不要多说,{NEWLINE}努力做出好节目……{SCROLL}
strings.en: Ahem, ahem, ah, ah... Yes, I am the{NEWLINE}Director! Starting today, this station{CLEAR}will broadcast wonderful shows praising{CLEAR}Team Rocket! No arguments, everyone.{CLEAR}Just work hard and make good shows...{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0069/0 | RV037: addition: US ‘do you hear me?’ added; restore 从今天开始

strings.zh: 哇！{NEWLINE}我正在练习模仿,{CLEAR}你是谁！？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Whoa! I was practicing my impression...{SCROLL}Who are you?!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0069/1 | RV037: meaning: zh: practicing an imitation

strings.zh: ……又是{VAR:0103:0}啊！{SCROLL}
strings.en: ...Oh no, it’s you again, {VAR:0103:0}?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 伦达『可恶,好不容易{NEWLINE}假扮成了台长,{CLEAR}正想把各地都变成{CLEAR}火箭队的颜色！{SCROLL}好吧,这次{NEWLINE}我们就来真正地决胜一场吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Petrel: Damn it! I finally managed to{NEWLINE}pass myself off as the Director, and I{CLEAR}was just about to paint the whole{CLEAR}region in Team Rocket’s colors! Fine,{CLEAR}this time let’s settle this for real!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0069/3 | RV037: meaning: US line rewrote; 可恶 / 好不容易假扮 / 变成火箭队的颜色 / 真正地决胜

strings.zh: 你找台长吗？{NEWLINE}他正在4楼的第一工作室{CLEAR}筹备新节目的录制呢。
strings.en: Looking for the director?{SCROLL}He’s in Studio 1 on 4F, getting ready to{NEWLINE}record a new show.

strings.zh: 台长每天要处理的大事很多,{NEWLINE}所以一些日常的小事{CLEAR}就由我来代办了。
strings.en: The director has lots of big things to{NEWLINE}deal with every day, so I handle the{CLEAR}little everyday things for him.

strings.zh: 台长『呀,是冠军大人啊！{NEWLINE}欢迎来到广播电台参观。{CLEAR}在这里不用拘束,{CLEAR}就当是自己的家一样就好。
strings.en: Director: Oh, it’s the Champion!{NEWLINE}Welcome to our radio station.{SCROLL}No need to stand on ceremony here.{NEWLINE}Make yourself at home.

strings.zh: ５层　……　台长室
strings.en: 5F Director’s Office

strings.zh: 上面　……　瞭望台
strings.en: Go up for Observation Deck

strings.zh: 哦！哦！是冠军大人！{SCROLL}太好了,外面的火箭队都被您解决了吗？
strings.en: Oh! Oh! It’s the Champion!{SCROLL}Thank goodness! Have you dealt with all{NEWLINE}the Rockets out there?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『不,坂木现在应该{NEWLINE}还在广播塔的塔顶,{CLEAR}我们还没有去跟他决战。{CLEAR}我听说台长室关押着人质,{CLEAR}所以特意先来确认你们的安全。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: No. Giovanni should still{NEWLINE}be on the roof of the Radio Tower.{CLEAR}We haven’t faced him yet.{SCROLL}I heard hostages were being held in the{NEWLINE}director’s office, so I came to make{CLEAR}sure you’re safe first.

strings.zh: 原来坂木他们搬着设备去了塔顶吗？{NEWLINE}您如果也要去塔顶的话,{CLEAR}必须打开三层的安全门才行。{CLEAR}请您拿着这个。
strings.en: So Giovanni and his men hauled the{NEWLINE}equipment up to the roof?{SCROLL}If you’re going up there too, you’ll{NEWLINE}need to open the security door on 3F.{CLEAR}Please take this.

strings.zh: 这是打开安全门用的钥匙卡,{NEWLINE}虽然被火箭队抢去了一张,{CLEAR}但幸好我还藏了张备用卡。
strings.en: This is the Card Key for the{NEWLINE}security door.{SCROLL}Team Rocket took one from us,{NEWLINE}but luckily I’d hidden a spare.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『多亏您藏了这张钥匙卡,{NEWLINE}这下要打开三楼的安全门就简单多了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Thanks to you hiding this Card{NEWLINE}Key, opening the security door on 3F{CLEAR}will be much easier now.

strings.zh: 冠军大人,我看坂木带了好多人来,{NEWLINE}还有一些从没见过的莫名其妙的精灵,{CLEAR}您跟他们战斗的话可要多加小心啊。
strings.en: Champion, Giovanni brought a lot of{NEWLINE}people with him,{SCROLL}and some strange Pokémon I’ve never{NEWLINE}seen before. Please be very careful{CLEAR}when you fight them.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『台长您放心好了,{NEWLINE}这次我是跟联盟四天王一起来的,{CLEAR}一定能在这里抓住坂木、消灭火箭队。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Don’t worry, Director.{NEWLINE}This time I came with the Elite Four.{SCROLL}We’ll catch Giovanni here and wipe out{NEWLINE}Team Rocket for sure.

strings.zh: 那就好、那就好。{NEWLINE}地区的和平安定就靠您了。
strings.en: That’s good, that’s good.{NEWLINE}The peace of the region is in{CLEAR}your hands.

strings.zh: 请冠军大人务必消灭火箭队,{NEWLINE}地区的和平安定就靠您了。
strings.en: Please, Champion, wipe out Team Rocket.{NEWLINE}The peace of the region is in{CLEAR}your hands.

strings.zh: 冠军大人,请一定要保证我们的安全啊。
strings.en: Champion, please make sure we{NEWLINE}stay safe.

strings.zh: 当我看到办公大楼冲进来一群{NEWLINE}穿着火箭队制服的人,{CLEAR}我还以为是台里搞的COS活动。{CLEAR}没想到他们竟然真的是火箭队！
strings.en: When a crowd of people in Team Rocket{NEWLINE}uniforms burst into the office building,{SCROLL}I thought it was some cosplay event the{NEWLINE}station was putting on. I never imagined{CLEAR}they were really Team Rocket!

strings.zh: 看到冠军大人您来我就放心了,{NEWLINE}我相信精灵联盟一定能够战胜火箭队,{CLEAR}请您加油啊。
strings.en: Now that you’re here, Champion,{NEWLINE}I feel safe.{SCROLL}I’m sure the Pokémon League can beat{NEWLINE}Team Rocket. Good luck!

strings.zh: 如果我也有自己的精灵,{NEWLINE}就能跟火箭队战斗了。
strings.en: If I had Pokémon of my own,{NEWLINE}I could fight Team Rocket too.

strings.zh: 就我那4枚徽章实力{NEWLINE}在火箭队面前根本不够看,{CLEAR}我真是愧对台长的信任……
strings.en: With only 4 Badges, I’m no match for{NEWLINE}Team Rocket at all.{SCROLL}I’ve really let down the{NEWLINE}director’s trust...
